title: Berlin Botanic Garden - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin Botanic Garden is a real destination, not a ten-minute Mitte detour.** Give the Dahlem journey and the visit their own space in the day.
**Start with the glasshouses when weather or time is fragile.** The Great Tropical House gives the visit a clear centre, then any outdoor loop becomes a bonus.
**Use the outdoor garden when the day is dry.** Choose one path, formal garden or arboretum stretch instead of trying to cross the whole site.

**Current practical checks matter.** The official visitor page lists summer hours, short-notice exceptions and current admission; the Botanical Museum exhibition areas are being modernised until about 2027.
Use Berlin Plant Passport to stamp your weather cover, honest time and garden aim into one calmer visit shape.
